an6.59:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā nādike viharati giñjakāvasathe.
an6.59:1.3: atha kho dārukammiko gahapati yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho dārukammikaṃ gahapatiṃ bhagavā etadavoca:
an6.59:1.4: api nu te gahapati kule dānaṃ dīyatīti.
an6.59:1.6: taṃ ca kho ye te bhikkhū āraññakā piṇḍapātikā paṃsukūlikā arahanto vā arahattamaggaṃ vā samāpannā. tathārūpesu me bhante bhikkhusu dānaṃ dīyatīti
an6.59:2.1: dujjānaṃ kho etaṃ gahapati tayā gihinā kāmabhoginā puttasambādhasayanaṃ ajjhāvasantena kāsikacandanaṃ paccanubhontena mālāgandhavilepanaṃ dhārayantena jātarūparajataṃ sādiyantena “ime vā arahanto, ime vā arahattamaggaṃ samāpannā”ti. (1)
an6.59:3.1: āraññako cepi gahapati bhikkhu hoti uddhato unnalo capalo mukharo vikiṇṇavāco muṭṭhassati asampajāno asamāhito vibbhantacitto pākatindriyo,
an6.59:3.3: āraññako cepi gahapati bhikkhu hoti anuddhato anunnalo acapalo amukharo avikiṇṇavāco upaṭṭhitasati sampajāno, samāhito ekaggacitto saṃvutindriyo,
an6.59:4.1: gāmantavihārī cepi gahapati bhikkhu hoti uddhato …pe… [pākatindriyo],
an6.59:4.3: gāmantavihārī cepi gahapati bhikkhu hoti anuddhato …pe… [saṃvutindriyo],
an6.59:5.1: piṇḍapātiko cepi gahapati bhikkhu hoti uddhato …pe… pākatindriyo.
an6.59:5.3: piṇḍapātiko cepi gahapati bhikkhu hoti anuddhato …pe… [saṃvutindriyo],
an6.59:6.1: nemantaniko cepi gahapati bhikkhu hoti uddhato …pe… [pākatindriyo],
an6.59:6.3: nemantaniko cepi gahapati bhikkhu hoti anuddhato …pe… saṃvutindriyo,
an6.59:7.1: paṃsukūliko cepi gahapati bhikkhu hoti uddhato …pe… [pākatindriyo],
an6.59:7.3: paṃsukūliko cepi gahapati bhikkhu hoti anuddhato …pe… saṃvutindriyo,
an6.59:8.1: gahapati cīvaradharo cepi gahapati bhikkhu hoti uddhato unnalo capalo mukharo vikiṇṇavāco muṭṭhassati asampajāno asamāhito vibbhantacitto pākatindriyo,
an6.59:8.3: gahapati cīvaradharo cepi gahapati bhikkhu hoti anuddhato anunnaloacapalo amukharo avikiṇṇavāco upaṭṭhitasati sampajāno samāhito ekaggacitto saṃvutindriyo,
an6.59:9.1: iṅgha tvaṃ gahapati saṅghe dānaṃ dehi.
an6.59:9.2: saṅghe te dānaṃ dadato cittaṃ pasīdissati.
an6.59:9.3: so tvaṃ pasannacitto kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjissasīti.
an6.59:9.4: esāhaṃ bhante ajjatagge saṅghe dānaṃ dassāmīti.
